---
title: "Region x Time: grouped questions"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

Same sample and region x time model as `10_region_time.Rmd` (religious groups in Southwest Asia, Europe, Africa and
East Asia, without eHRAF and Pulotu, start year from 3000 BCE to 1500 CE, any time span; child questions as answered;
conflicting answers left out), for two grouped child questions:

- **elite ties** (supreme high god): is monarch fused, is monarch manifestation, is kin to elites, other elite loyalty
- **murder out-group** (monitoring): murder other religions, murder other polities

Rule: "Yes" if any answered question in the group is "Yes", otherwise "No". Entries that answer only some questions
of a group are kept (a "No" from a partial answer may be a "Yes" had the rest been answered; see the table below).

Run from inside `modeling/` after `3_prepare_data.py`. Fits are saved in `fits/` (`region_time_grouped_*`; delete
them to refit), figures in `fig/region_time_grouped/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

options(mc.cores = 4, brms.backend = "cmdstanr")
dir.create("fits", showWarnings = FALSE)
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 11))

# figures: shown in the session and saved as fig/region_time_grouped/<name>.jpg
fig_dir <- "fig/region_time_grouped"
dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
save_plot <- function(p, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, paste0(name, ".jpg")), p, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300)
  p
}

regions <- c("Southwest Asia", "Europe", "Africa", "East Asia")
region_colors <- c("Southwest Asia" = "#2a78d6", "Europe" = "#eb6834", "Africa" = "#1baf7a", "East Asia" = "#eda100",
                   "average" = "#52514e")
year_min <- -3000
year_max <- 1500

groups <- list(
  "elite ties" = c("is monarch fused", "is monarch manifestation", "is kin to elites", "other elite loyalty"),
  "murder out-group" = c("murder other religions", "murder other polities")
)
```

# Data

```{r data, message = FALSE}
source_of <- read_csv("../data/sccsrv3/entry_data.csv", col_select = c(entry_id, data_source)) |>
  distinct(entry_id, .keep_all = TRUE)

items <- enframe(groups, name = "group", value = "question_short") |> unnest(question_short)
d <- read_csv("data/model_data.csv") |>
  left_join(source_of, by = "entry_id") |>
  filter(
    poll == "group",
    world_region %in% regions,
    is.na(data_source) | (data_source != "eHRAF" & !str_starts(data_source, "Pulotu")),
    year_from >= year_min, year_from < year_max,
    weight == 1, !inferred
  ) |>
  inner_join(items, by = "question_short") |>
  mutate(region = factor(world_region, levels = regions), time = year_from / 1000)
stopifnot(setequal(unique(d$question_short), items$question_short))

# one row per entry and group
grouped <- d |>
  group_by(group, entry_id, region, year_from, time) |>
  summarise(answer_value = as.integer(any(answer_value == 1)), n_items = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(complete = n_items == lengths(groups)[group])
```

Entries per group: share "Yes", and entries that answered only some of the group's questions (partial), of which
all answered questions are "No" (coded "No", but uncertain):

```{r data_groups}
grouped |>
  group_by(group) |>
  summarise(entries = n(), share_yes = mean(answer_value), partial = sum(!complete),
            partial_no = sum(!complete & answer_value == 0))
grouped |> count(group, region) |> pivot_wider(names_from = region, values_from = n)
```

# Fit

```{r fit, message = FALSE, results = "hide"}
# brms names the region coefficients without spaces (regionSouthwestAsia, regionSouthwestAsia:time, ...)
region_key <- setNames(regions, str_remove_all(regions, " "))
priors <- reduce(
  map(paste0("region", names(region_key)), ~ set_prior("normal(0, 1.5)", class = "b", coef = .x)),
  c,
  .init = prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b")
)

fits <- tibble(question = names(groups)) |>
  mutate(fit = map(question, function(q) {
    brm(answer_value ~ 0 + region + region:time, data = filter(grouped, group == q), family = bernoulli(),
        prior = priors, chains = 4, iter = 4000, warmup = 2000, seed = 125123, refresh = 0,
        control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99), file = sprintf("fits/region_time_grouped_%s", q))
  }))
```

# Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
fits |>
  mutate(diag = map(fit, function(fit) {
    s <- summarise_draws(as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_", regex = TRUE))
    tibble(max_rhat = max(s$rhat), min_ess_bulk = min(s$ess_bulk), min_ess_tail = min(s$ess_tail),
           divergences = sum(subset(nuts_params(fit), Parameter == "divergent__")$Value))
  })) |>
  select(-fit) |>
  unnest(diag)
```

# Slopes per region

Change in log-odds per 1,000 years within each region (mean and 95% interval), and the average of the four
region slopes (grey).

```{r slopes, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
# region slopes per draw, plus their average
region_slopes <- function(fit) {
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region.*:time$", regex = TRUE) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    select(.draw, starts_with("b_")) |>
    pivot_longer(-.draw, values_to = "value") |>
    mutate(region = unname(region_key[str_remove(str_remove(name, "^b_region"), ":time$")])) |>
    select(.draw, region, value)
  average <- draws |> group_by(.draw) |> summarise(value = mean(value)) |> mutate(region = "average")
  bind_rows(draws, average)
}

estimates <- fits |>
  mutate(est = map(fit, function(fit) {
    region_slopes(fit) |>
      group_by(region) |>
      summarise(mean = mean(value), lower = quantile(value, 0.025), upper = quantile(value, 0.975),
                p_positive = mean(value > 0))
  })) |>
  select(question, est) |>
  unnest(est) |>
  mutate(region = factor(region, levels = c(regions, "average")), question = factor(question, levels = rev(names(groups))))
estimates

p_slopes <- ggplot(estimates, aes(mean, question, colour = region, group = fct_rev(region))) +  # top to bottom in legend order
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper), position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), size = 0.15) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = region_colors, breaks = c(regions, "average")) +
  labs(x = "Time slope within region (log-odds per 1,000 years)", y = NULL, colour = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
save_plot(p_slopes, "slopes", 8, 3)
```

# Curves over time

- **Overall** (black line, grey band: 95% interval): the "typical region", logit⁻¹(ᾱ + β̄·time) with ᾱ and β̄ the
  averages of the four region intercepts and slopes (per draw).
- **Regions** (coloured lines): posterior mean, drawn over the region's data range (first to last start year);
  dashed where the 500-year rolling window has fewer than 10 entries.
- **Data** (points): share yes per region in 500-year bins of start year (lower edge included), size = number of
  entries, regions shifted slightly around the bin midpoint. Black-outlined points: all four regions pooled.

```{r curves, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 4.5}
years <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 50)
answers <- rename(grouped, question = group)

# overall curve: average region intercept and slope per draw
overall_curves <- fits |>
  mutate(curve = map(fit, function(fit) {
    draws <- as_draws_df(fit, variable = "^b_region", regex = TRUE) |> as_tibble()
    a <- rowMeans(select(draws, starts_with("b_region") & !ends_with(":time")))
    b <- rowMeans(select(draws, starts_with("b_region") & ends_with(":time")))
    p <- plogis(outer(a, rep(1, length(years))) + outer(b, years / 1000))
    tibble(year = years, mean = colMeans(p), lo95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.025), hi95 = apply(p, 2, quantile, 0.975))
  })) |>
  select(question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve)

# entries per region in 500-year rolling windows of start year (centred every 50 years)
rolling <- map_dfr(years, function(centre) {
  answers |>
    filter(year_from >= centre - 250, year_from < centre + 250) |>
    count(question, region) |>
    mutate(year = centre)
})

# region curves (posterior mean) within each region's data range, solid where the rolling window has at least 10 entries
grid <- crossing(region = factor(regions, levels = regions), year = years) |> mutate(time = year / 1000)
data_range <- answers |>
  group_by(question, region) |>
  summarise(from = floor(min(year_from) / 50) * 50, to = ceiling(max(year_from) / 50) * 50, .groups = "drop")
region_lines <- fits |>
  mutate(curve = map(fit, ~ mutate(grid, mean = colMeans(posterior_epred(.x, newdata = grid))))) |>
  select(question, curve) |>
  unnest(curve) |>
  inner_join(data_range, by = c("question", "region")) |>
  filter(year >= from, year <= to) |>
  left_join(rolling, by = c("question", "region", "year")) |>
  mutate(solid = if_else(replace_na(n, 0) >= 10, mean, NA_real_))

# observed share per region (shifted around the bin midpoint) and pooled, in 500-year bins of start year
bin_edges <- seq(year_min, year_max, by = 500)
offsets <- setNames(c(-75, -25, 25, 75), regions)
binned <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(question, region, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250 + offsets[as.character(region)])
binned_pooled <- answers |>
  mutate(bin = findInterval(year_from, bin_edges)) |>
  group_by(question, bin) |>
  summarise(share = mean(answer_value), n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(year = bin_edges[bin] + 250)

together_colors <- c(region_colors[regions], overall = "black")
p_curves <- ggplot(mapping = aes(year)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = c(0, 1), colour = "grey85", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_ribbon(data = overall_curves, aes(ymin = lo95, ymax = hi95), fill = "grey60", alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = binned, aes(y = share, colour = region, size = n), alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_line(data = region_lines, aes(y = mean, colour = region, group = region), linewidth = 0.5, linetype = "22") +
  geom_line(data = region_lines, aes(y = solid, colour = region, group = region), linewidth = 0.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_line(data = overall_curves, aes(y = mean, colour = "overall"), linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_point(data = binned_pooled, aes(y = share, size = n), shape = 21, fill = "white", colour = "black", stroke = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(~ factor(question, levels = names(groups))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = together_colors, breaks = names(together_colors), labels = c(regions, "overall (typical region)")) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 4.5, breaks = c(1, 5, 10, 20, 40)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(year_min, year_max, by = 1000)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1)) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1), xlim = c(year_min, year_max)) +
  labs(x = "Year (start year)", y = "P(yes)", colour = NULL, size = "entries") +
  theme(legend.position = "top", panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7))
save_plot(p_curves, "curves", 9, 4.5)
```
